title: vicia monantha subsp. cinerea
intro: Vicia monantha subsp. cinerea, commonly known as Grey Vetch, is a plant species within the legume family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which may include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Grey Vetch are thought to be attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Grey Vetch include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
